sources.title: Standard patch window runbook
paragraphs: Patch windows start after business hours in the client's local time and finish before the next opening.
Confirm a current backup exists before the window opens and note it on the ticket.
Reference phrase for this runbook: heron-msp-canary-2208.

sources.title: Escalation path template
paragraphs: Tier 1 escalates to Tier 2 after thirty minutes without progress on a priority one ticket.
Tier 2 escalates to the on-call lead, who decides whether the client is called.
